title: ctaudit / ELB report
description: The ctaudit ELB HTML report rebuilt from the request and conn lines ctaudit ships to Loki (--loki, or serve elb). Tables count every line in the time range; Loki stores lines at ship time, so the range must cover the scan runs, not the request times.

list.name: client_ip
list.label: Client IP (regex)
list.description: Regular expression on the client IP.

list.name: status
list.label: ELB status (regex)
list.description: Regular expression on the ELB status, for example 5..

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" [$__range]))

sum(sum_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json received_bytes="received_bytes", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | received_bytes!="" | keep received_bytes | unwrap received_bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))

sum(sum_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json sent_bytes="sent_bytes", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | sent_bytes!="" | keep sent_bytes | unwrap sent_bytes | __error__="" [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status=~"4.." [$__range]))

sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status=~"5.." [$__range]))

panels.title: Latency avg

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | latency!="" | keep latency | unwrap latency | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

panels.description: request_time + target_time + response_time. Requests with an unknown latency are left out.

targets.expr: max_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json latency="latency", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | latency!="" | keep latency | unwrap latency | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

count(sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" [$__range])))

panels.title: Requests by load balancer

targets.expr: sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" [$__interval]))

panels.description: Loki stores each line at the time ctaudit shipped it, not the request time. Pick a time range that covers the scan runs; the real request time is the event_time column.

panels.title: Requests by ELB status class

targets.expr: sum by (class) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format class=`{{ substr 0 1 .elb_status }}xx` [$__interval]))

panels.description: Loki stores each line at the time ctaudit shipped it, not the request time. Pick a time range that covers the scan runs; the real request time is the event_time column.

targets.expr: topk($top, sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | keep lb [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (elb_status) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | elb_status!="" | keep elb_status [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (target_status) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target_status="target_status", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target_status!="" | keep target_status [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (client_ip) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | client_ip!="" | keep client_ip [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (host) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json host="host", domain_name="domain_name", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format host=`{{ if .host }}{{ .host }}{{ else }}{{ .domain_name }}{{ end }}` | host!="" | keep host [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (path) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json path="path", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | label_format path=`{{ regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" (regexReplaceAll "/[0-9]+([./]|$)" .path "/{n}${1}") "/{n}${1}" }}` | path!="" | keep path [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (user_agent) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json user_agent="user_agent", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | user_agent!="" | keep user_agent [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (target) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json target="target", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | target!="" | keep target [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (method) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json method="method", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | method!="" | keep method [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (type) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json type="type", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | type!="" | keep type [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (actions) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json actions="actions", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | actions!="" | keep actions [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (ssl_protocol) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | ssl_protocol!="" | keep ssl_protocol [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (ssl_cipher) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json ssl_cipher="ssl_cipher", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | ssl_cipher!="" | keep ssl_cipher [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (error_reason) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json error_reason="error_reason", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | error_reason!="" | keep error_reason [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (classification) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="request", lb=~"$lb"} | json classification="classification", client_ip="client_ip", elb_status="elb_status" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | elb_status=~"$status" | classification!="" | keep classification [$__range])))
sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range]))

panels.title: TLS

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | ssl_protocol!="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Connections that negotiated a TLS protocol.

panels.title: Failed handshakes (443)

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json listener="listener", ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | listener="443" | ssl_protocol="" [$__range]))

panels.description: Connections on listener 443 with no TLS protocol.

targets.expr: avg_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json tls_handshake_time="tls_handshake_time", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | tls_handshake_time!="" | keep tls_handshake_time | unwrap tls_handshake_time | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()

max_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json tls_handshake_time="tls_handshake_time", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | tls_handshake_time!="" | keep tls_handshake_time | unwrap tls_handshake_time | __error__="" [$__range]) by ()
count(sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" [$__range])))
topk($top, sum by (lb) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | keep lb [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (listener_tls) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json listener="listener", ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | label_format listener_tls=`{{ .listener }} {{ if .ssl_protocol }}{{ .ssl_protocol }}{{ else }}no TLS{{ end }}` | listener_tls!="" | keep listener_tls [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (ssl_protocol) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json ssl_protocol="ssl_protocol", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | ssl_protocol!="" | keep ssl_protocol [$__range])))

topk($top, sum by (tls_key_exchange) (count_over_time({job=~"$job", subcommand="elb", kind="conn", lb=~"$lb"} | json tls_key_exchange="tls_key_exchange", client_ip="client_ip" | __error__="" | client_ip=~"$client_ip" | tls_key_exchange!="" | keep tls_key_exchange [$__range])))
